title: Cheque bounce
docs: Cheque, bank return memo, demand notice, delivery proof
timing: Notice ordinarily within 30 days of bank intimation; allow 15 days after receipt for payment. Check filing limitation with counsel.

title: Consumer complaint
timing: Ordinary limitation is two years from cause of action, subject to condonation.

title: FIR or police complaint
authority: Police station; escalate to Superintendent of Police if recording is refused
timing: Report promptly; preserve electronic evidence and keep the acknowledgement.

title: Tenant or landlord dispute
authority: State rent authority or civil court depending on local law
docs: Tenancy agreement, receipts, notices, possession evidence
law: Applicable state rent law and Transfer of Property Act
timing: Notice and forum depend on tenancy and local statute.

title: Property dispute
authority: Jurisdictional civil court or competent revenue authority
docs: Title chain, sale deed, survey record, possession evidence
law: Specific Relief Act and applicable property law
timing: Obtain certified copies before selecting a remedy.

title: Divorce or maintenance
authority: Family Court or competent Magistrate depending on relief
docs: Marriage proof, income records, expenses, dependent details
law: Applicable matrimonial law; BNSS section 144 for eligible maintenance claims
timing: Interim and final relief follow different schedules.

title: Workplace harassment
authority: Internal Committee or district Local Committee as applicable
timing: Ordinarily complain within three months of the incident or last incident; a reasoned extension is possible.

title: Cyber financial fraud
authority: Bank, national cybercrime helpline 1930 and cybercrime reporting portal
docs: Transaction IDs, bank alerts, screenshots, complaint number
law: Applicable IT Act and BNS offences depend on facts
timing: Contact the bank and report immediately; recovery is uncertain.

title: Unpaid salary
authority: Employer, then competent labour authority or civil forum
law: Applicable wage law and contract terms
timing: Identify worker classification and applicable limitation before filing.

title: Right to Information
authority: Public Information Officer of the public authority holding the records
docs: Record description, date range, fee or exemption proof
timing: Ordinary response period is 30 days, subject to statutory exceptions.
